subject: Request: Temporary SLA delegation + sprint cadence for P1/P2 coverage
messages:
From: Tom Cheng <tom.cheng@matrixpay.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: support@matrixpay.com
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Night-time P1 handling during M&A sprint

Hi Lukas,

We ran into a P1 last night that stretched across the 02:00-04:00 PST window. Our on-call responder took a while to reach the right tier, and that led to a 28-minute time-to-first-response. Given MatrixPay's live settlement flows overnight, this is riskier than our previous load profile suggested.

We need a short-term change for the next 4 weeks while we run our M&A migration sprint: can Redwood commit to a delegated on-call contact that can accept P1 escalations within 10 minutes during 00:00-05:00 PST, with an internal escalation ladder documented?

If Redwood can accept a temporary SLA amendment we can pursue a 30-day extension of our trial and move forward with procurement. Attached is our incident timeline for last night (incident-621.log).

Thanks,
Tom Cheng
Head of Payments Ops
MatrixPay

Attachments: incident-621.log (text), settlement-snapshot.csv (csv)

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Tom Cheng <tom.cheng@matrixpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Night-time P1 handling during M&A sprint

Tom — thanks for the details and the timeline. Sorry you had that experience. Quick answers up front: we can implement a temporary escalation path and designate a Primary Redwood responder for the overnight window for up to 30 days, but I need internal sign-off on two items: (1) delegated contact and permission to accept incident calls on Redwood's behalf during that window, and (2) whether MatrixPay accepts a limited SLA credit if response slips due to cross-account capacity constraints.

Proposal I put together (attached): a one-month "overnight coverage delegation" where Redwood will:  
- Provide an on-call contact who will pick up P1 escalations within 10 minutes for 00:00-05:00 PST, Monday–Sunday  
- Maintain a documented escalation ladder (Tier 1 -> Tier 2 -> On-call manager) with contact numbers and SMS fallbacks  
- Triage and attempt mitigation within 30 minutes, with status updates every 15 minutes until resolution  

I'll loop in Karthik and Grace to confirm operational feasibility. If that works for you I can route a short amendment to the SOW for signatures.

Lukas
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Attachments: matrixpay-sla-variance-prop.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Night-time P1 handling during M&A sprint

Lukas / Grace — reviewed the proposal. Operational notes:  
1) We can staff a Primary responder for the 00:00-05:00 PST window from our EU night squad for a 4-week carveout; that person will be authorized to own P1 triage and call MatrixPay stakeholders.  
2) To avoid repeated handoffs, the responder will have a direct escalation to an on-call infra lead (phone + PagerDuty) who can hot-swap capacity.  
3) We need MatrixPay to accept the following limited exception language in the SOW: "Redwood will endeavor to meet a 10-minute first-response objective during the delegated window; credits apply only for failures of Redwood's control plane or eviction-level hardware failures."

Operational ask: Grace, can you produce the concrete on-call rota (names, phone, PD escalation) and a 1-page runbook excerpt for MatrixPay to review? I'll approve the amendment once runbook + rota are attached. Naomi, FYI for SLA exposure.

Karthik
VP, Product Ops

Attachments: oncall-rotation-proposal.xlsx

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Tom Cheng <tom.cheng@matrixpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2026 17:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Night-time P1 handling during M&A sprint

Tom — quick update following internal alignment:  
- We can provision the delegated overnight contact starting 2026-06-25 for a 28-day window. The Primary responder will be reachable via the emergency number listed in the attached rota.  
- We added the exception clause Karthik mentioned; we captured it in a short amendment and included a runbook snapshot. Please confirm that MatrixPay accepts the limited-credit language and the start date. Once you confirm, I'll ask legal to issue the amendment for signature (DocuSign link below).

Next steps for MatrixPay:  
1) Reply to confirm acceptance of limited-credit exception and start date  
2) Provide any compliance constraints (e.g., requirement for encrypted calls or specific contact process)  
3) Sign DocuSign amendment (link)

DocuSign: https://na1.docusign.net/AAABBB-XYZ

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Attachments: runbook-snapshot-20260620.txt
